endpoints.name: Verify Enterprise Electronic Seal PIN (draft)
endpoints.description: Checks whether the PIN of a seal credential is accepted, before the seal is saved. Nothing is saved, signed, counted against quota or logged with the PIN: the server opens the credential on RSSP, requires it to belong to the enterprise (certificate tax code equals the enterprise tax code), then asks RSSP to authorize a probe digest and discards the result. Without seal_id the credential comes only from the body. With seal_id (edit form) the keys the body leaves out are filled from the stored seal, as Update does, and an empty or masked pin falls back to the stored PIN only while signing_server, connector_name and credential_id are the stored ones; changing any of them needs a real pin. A wrong PIN counts against the credential's attempt counter on RSSP, so the check is rate limited per enterprise and credential (5 checks per 5 minutes by default, counted in memory on each node). Owner only.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer access token.

headers.name: x-language-name
headers.description: Language of the error message. Supported values are `en` and `vi`.

headers.name: Content-Type
headers.description: The MIME type of the request body: application/json.

request_fields.name: seal_id
request_fields.description: Seal the edit form is changing. When set, keys left out of credential_configuration are filled from the stored seal, and an empty or masked pin uses the stored PIN while the credential is unchanged. Leave out for a new seal.

request_fields.name: credential_configuration
request_fields.description: Credential block of the Add and Update request, same keys and meaning.

response_fields.name: result
response_fields.description: PIN_VERIFIED when RSSP accepted the PIN; PIN_NOT_REQUIRED for an IMPLICIT_TSE credential.

404: seal_id names no seal of the enterprise
400: seal_id given, signing server, connector or credential id differs from the stored seal, and no real pin sent
400: the enterprise profile has no tax code
400: RSSP has no such credential, or its certificate does not belong to the enterprise
429: too many PIN checks for this credential; retry_after_seconds and Retry-After say when
400: no pin sent and none stored, while the credential needs a PIN
400: RSSP rejected the PIN; remaining_counter says how many attempts are left
400: credential temporarily locked after wrong PINs; temp_lockout_duration says for how long
400: credential authorizes in a mode other than PIN or IMPLICIT_TSE
400: credential has no certificate to authorize
500: RSSP connection could not be opened
400: the credential's certificate is not ready
400: connector is not used for signing
500: RSSP authorize call failed; never reported as a wrong PIN
500: seal registry could not be read (seal_id given)
500: unexpected failure while reading the seal (seal_id given)

403: the caller lacks ENTERPRISE_ESEAL_CREATE (no seal_id) or ENTERPRISE_ESEAL_UPDATE (seal_id edits a saved seal); checked once the body is valid and before any PIN check or rate-limit count (RBAC enforce mode)

request_fields.description: Starting grants as feature switches; each key once. The role is created holding the permissions of the enabled keys, and a key with enabled false writes nothing. The caller cannot enable a key whose permissions it does not hold. Mutually exclusive with permissions.

endpoints.name: Update Role Permissions

headers.description: Language of the error message. Supported values are `en` and `vi`.

path_params.description: ENTERPRISE_ROLE.ID of the role, never the base role_id.

request_fields.name: features
request_fields.description: Alias of feature, with the same meaning and the same validation; the response bodies spell it this way. Sending both feature and features, even as empty arrays, is refused with 400 (sub-code 117) and nothing is written.

request_fields.description: Version read from the catalog; a stale version is rejected with 409.

request_fields.description: New role name, trimmed before it is written. Omitted or blank leaves the name unchanged. May be sent with or without permission changes; with them, it is written only after every permission guard has passed.

request_fields.description: New role remark. Omitted leaves it unchanged; an empty string clears it. Sending both remark and description is refused with 400 (sub-code 117) and nothing is written.

request_fields.description: SigningHub name of remark, the key PUT /v1/enterprise/roles/{enterpriseRoleId}/basic reads; same column, same rules.

request_fields.description: True to make the role the default role, as on PUT /v1/enterprise/roles/{enterpriseRoleId}/basic. Omitted leaves the flag unchanged.

response_fields.description: True when the RBAC cache was reloaded.

response_fields.name: cache_version
response_fields.description: RBAC cache version after the reload.

response_fields.name: failure
response_fields.description: First failing item; null when every item was written.

response_fields.name: feature_changes
response_fields.description: Result per feature switch; omitted when none.

response_fields.name: affected_features
response_fields.description: Features whose state changed as a side effect; omitted when none.

error_codes.condition: 400: token is not a user token
500: enterprise context could not be loaded
400: body empty or invalid, no change given, both feature and features present, both remark and description present, or name/remark too long
400: feature mixed with changes or group_changes
422: action not ALLOW, DENY or RESET
422: permission or group not in the catalog
409: feature blocked by a group DENY
403: change in a protected permission group
403: grant the caller does not hold
503: changes written but the RBAC cache could not be reloaded
503: permission catalog must be reloaded first
500: current grants could not be read; 503: the save lost its write lock part-way and stopped (failure.phase LOCK_LOST), rows written before that are kept and the repeat save writes the rest
404: role removed before its name or remark was written

endpoints.name: Add Package To Category
endpoints.description: Adds one category to the workflow of a package, together with its ancestors, and leaves the categories the package already carries alone. Adding a category that is already attached succeeds. Shaped after SigningHub 10.0 `POST /v4/packages/{id}/move_to`, with deliberate differences: `add_to` instead of `move_to` because a workflow carries many categories; `category_id` instead of `folder_name`; removing is a separate route. The caller must be able to view the category. A participant of the workflow needs WORKFLOW_ASSIGN_CATEGORY to attach a personal category. An enterprise category may be attached by anyone who acts in the package's enterprise and holds WORKFLOW_ENTERPRISE_ASSIGN_CATEGORY, whether or not they take part in the workflow, and by the package owner with WORKFLOW_ASSIGN_CATEGORY. A refused caller gets the answer of a package that does not exist.

headers.name: Authorization

headers.name: x-language-name
headers.description: Language of the error message. Supported values are `en` and `vi`.

headers.name: Content-Type
headers.description: The MIME type of the request body: application/json.

request_fields.description: ID of the template; must be positive.

error_codes.condition: 400: body is not a valid CreateWorkflowFromTemplateRequest
400: the template is already being applied
400: the template is a draft its creator has not saved
400: workflow created but next signer not set

403: template is ECONTRACT and the caller lacks the ECONTRACT workflow type permission (no draft is created)

endpoints.name: Fill Form Fields
endpoints.description: Fills form fields of a document (text, custom, checkbox, radio, date, QR, stamp, camera, attachment, hyperlink, combobox, toggle, numeric stepper, VNeID) as the calling participant. x-handle-transaction gives idempotency for 10 minutes. On an ECONTRACT workflow the value of an eLabor field is checked before it is stored: an empty required value, a malformed date, gender, amount or years, or a job position that is not exactly one option fails that field with 57.21, 57.25, 57.23 or 57.24 (field name in `field`).

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer access token.

headers.name: x-language-name
headers.description: Language of the error message. Supported values are `en` and `vi`.

headers.name: x-handle-transaction
headers.description: Value returned by an earlier call; a repeat within 10 minutes returns success without processing.

headers.name: x-idempotency-skip-error
headers.description: When `true`, fields already filled are skipped instead of failing.

headers.name: Content-Type
headers.description: The MIME type of the request body: application/json.

error_codes.condition: 400: body is not a valid ProcessingRequest

endpoints.needs_review: Served by DocumentService.fillFormField (document domain): blocking validation, RSSP basic flow and ProcessingMultipleField per field type return many codes (30.x, 31.x, 12.x and others) not traced here. The ProcessingRequest schema is left inline to avoid clashing with the document group's definition.

request_fields.name: field_name
request_fields.description: Name of the field, unique in the document; at most the configured max_field_name length.

request_fields.name: type
request_fields.description: Field type name; when present it must be a known type under the URL field type, else invalid field type.

request_fields.name: dimension
request_fields.description: Position and size; width and height must be greater than 0 on add.

request_fields.name: required
request_fields.description: Whether the field must be filled (deserialized as any JSON value).

request_fields.name: suffix

request_fields.name: keyword_placement

endpoints.name: Get Credential Registration Status
endpoints.description: Queries the RSS provider for the status of a certificate registration transaction. The connector defaults to SMART_ID_RSS_VNeID when x-connector-name is absent. A transaction code that is the caller's own Trusted SIC issuance is answered from the Trusted SIC session instead, whatever x-connector-name says. The status follows RSS: `DONE` once the certificate is issued, and `data` then carries `requestType` (`NEW_REGISTRATION`), `credentialId`, `serialNumber` and `certificateData` on every poll after completion, not only on the poll that completed it. Differences from RSS: `citizenPid` is never returned (the citizen id is not stored for Trusted SIC), and before completion `status` is `PENDING`, `FAILED`, `EXPIRED` or `CANCELED` with no `data`. A Trusted SIC issuance also ends on its own, without any poll: Trusted SIC calls a one-time callback or the server checks it, then the enrollment is updated and an `ISSUING_CERTIFICATE_EVENT` is sent to the `webhook_url` of the finish request (no `webhook_url`, no event), with the status `SUCCESS`, `FAILED` or `EXPIRED` and the transaction id of the finish request. An issuance that Trusted SIC completes at once is answered inline by the finish request itself (`status` SUCCESS) and sends no event.

endpoints.name: Get Signing Transaction Status
endpoints.description: Returns the status of an RSS signing transaction (type SIGNING) or, when no signing transaction matches, of a pending data-sharing request (type SHARING). A sharing request is dropped from memory after three polls. The `data` keys are the camelCase names of the transaction-to-bill cache object, which is what the route writes: `transactionCode`, `billCodeMap`, `requestTimestamp`, `webhook` and, when set, `metadata`. A transaction code that is the caller's own Trusted SIC signing session is answered from the Trusted SIC session instead. `data` has the same keys, with `billCodeMap` repeating `transactionCode` (Trusted SIC has no separate bill code), `requestTimestamp` the creation time of the session and `webhook` the `webhook_url` it was started with (omitted when there is none), plus the additional key `signatures`: the base64 signatures in the order of the signed digests, empty until signing completes. `status` is `PENDING`, `PROCESSING` (signed, the signature is being applied to the document), `SUCCESS`, `FAILED`, `EXPIRED`, `CANCELED` or `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`. A workflow field signed through `sign_rssp` ends on its own, without any poll, and is announced with a DOCUMENT_SIGNING_EVENT.

endpoints.name: Sign Document via RSSP Directly
endpoints.description: Starts signing one signature field of a package document with a remote credential. The package is blocked for five minutes while the provider asks the signer to authorize; the response tells the client how the signer authorizes and which signing_transaction_id to use with RSSP Credential Authorization. With a Trusted SIC credential the waiting response (`status` WAITING APPROVAL) also carries `view_url`, the Trusted SIC page where the signer approves, and `validity_period` is the lifetime of that page, not 300 seconds; the package stays blocked for as long. The signature is applied to the document when the signer approves, without any further call: Trusted SIC calls a one-time callback or the server checks the approval, and the result is announced with a DOCUMENT_SIGNING_EVENT to the request's `webhook_url`.

endpoints.name: Open Trusted SIC Management View
endpoints.description: Opens the Trusted SIC certificate management page for the certificate owner. The caller must own the credential: the citizen id in the caller's token (VNeID SSO login) must equal the CCCD/CMND value in the certificate subject. Outside strict validation mode a valid citizen id in the x-citizen-id header is used instead of the token's. The owner opens view_url; Trusted SIC reports the outcome to a one-time webhook and GET /v1/csc/credentials/{transactionCode}/status returns it with type MANAGE. The management session is kept in the application cache, not in the database: with the default in-memory cache it lives on the instance that opened it and is lost on restart, so a webhook or a status poll that reaches another instance, or comes after a restart, does not find it (the webhook gets its empty 404). Enable Redis (gopaperless.workflow.redis.enabled) to run several instances.

endpoints.name: Get Sign Hash From Service
endpoints.description: Signs client-computed document digests with an RSS credential, outside any workflow. Synchronous mode (S, default) returns the signatures; asynchronous mode (A) returns an authorization request to poll. On a Trusted SIC connector (connector_name TRUSTED_SIC) only mode A is supported: the response is WAITING APPROVAL with a view_url the user opens to approve, and the signatures come from GET /v1/csc/signing/{transactionCode}/status. A request that omits operation_mode runs as mode A there; a request that sends operation_mode S is refused with 400 (15.96). A connector that is neither RSS nor Trusted SIC is refused with 400 (45.55) before any signature quota is reserved.

endpoints.name: Save Template
endpoints.description: Finishes the create screen: turns a draft template into an active one, for good. A template created from a file (`POST /v1/settings/templates`, `POST /v1/enterprise/templates`) is a draft until its creator calls this route at the end of the create screen; an active template cannot go back. Templates saved from a package and cloned templates are created active. The caller must be allowed to edit the template (the creator of the draft holding the create permission of its scope, or a holder of the update permission), and the template must carry the workflow settings and source document a new workflow needs. Saving a template that is already active answers 200 and changes nothing; its creator may repeat the call even without the update right, anyone else needs it. endpoints.description: Places a field on the template's document. It accepts every field type the document Add Field API accepts. A `qrcode` field must carry fixed content: one with `allow_unauthenticated_workflow_view` true is rejected (43.25), because its URL needs the uuid of a workflow that does not exist yet. endpoints.name: Re-drive Trusted Billing Payment Webhook
endpoints.description: Runs one paid Trusted Billing bill through the payment webhook pipeline again, under the same per-bill lock. The operator, reason and evidence are recorded in SYSTEM_LOG first; the bill is re-read from Trusted Billing and must be PAID. An ACTIVE or SUSPENDED owner link answers ALREADY_SETTLED; a CANCELLED, FAILED or EXPIRED link, or several payments, is refused. The owner override is used only when no local payment exists and the verified evidence names no owner; an existing owner link is never reassigned. Requires a token that is not from a password login.

response_fields.description: Owner link status (0 PENDING, 1 ACTIVE, 2 FAILED, 3 CANCELLED, 4 SUSPENDED, 5 EXPIRED).

409: override given but the bill already has a local payment, the evidence resolved the owner, or the override does not match the TBS customer (enterprise: active, tax code equals the customer tax id; user: activated, email equals the customer email; a customer without that field refuses)

400: no override and the evidence names no owner; parked
503: a webhook delivery held the bill for the whole lock wait

endpoints.name: Add Personal Contact
endpoints.description: Adds a personal contact for the signed-in user. When address_book_name matches one of the caller's address books (enterprise books in an enterprise context, personal books otherwise), the contact is placed in that book. endpoints.name: Client Credentials Authentication

headers.name: x-language-name
headers.description: Language of the error message. Supported values are `en` and `vi`.

headers.name: Content-Type
headers.description: The MIME type of the request body: application/json.

request_fields.name: grant_type
request_fields.description: Kind of token request. `client_credential` and `password` issue a new token; `refresh_token` exchanges a refresh token.

request_fields.name: client_id
request_fields.description: Application name configured in the Enterprise Account integration settings.

request_fields.name: client_secret
request_fields.description: API key generated in the Enterprise Account.

request_fields.name: username
request_fields.description: Email of the user account. Required when grant_type is `password`.

request_fields.name: password
request_fields.description: Password of the account in `username`. Required when grant_type is `password`.

request_fields.name: refresh_token
request_fields.description: Refresh token to exchange. Required when grant_type is `refresh_token`.

request_fields.name: remember_me_enabled
request_fields.description: When true, a refresh token is returned with the access token. Default false.

request_fields.name: scope
request_fields.description: Participant UUID used to act on behalf of an enterprise user.

response_fields.name: access_token
response_fields.description: Access token to send as `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.

response_fields.name: expires_in
response_fields.description: Seconds until the access token expires.

response_fields.name: refresh_token
response_fields.description: Refresh token, present when one was issued.

response_fields.name: refresh_expires_in
response_fields.description: Seconds until the refresh token expires.

error_codes.condition: 400: body is not a valid LoginRequest
401: unknown client_id, or differs from the refresh session
401: refresh session missing, rotated or revoked

endpoints.needs_review: Credential, account-lock and lookup failures return (1.<status>) where <status> comes from stored procedures (USP_USER_LOGIN, API key / enterprise lookups); values are not in the repository.

endpoints.name: Single Sign On Authentication
endpoints.description: Exchanges a token issued by a trusted identity provider for a GoPaperless access token. Only the OAUTH2 method is processed; the calling application authenticates with the x-client-id and x-client-secret headers.

headers.name: x-language-name
headers.description: Language of the error message. Supported values are `en` and `vi`.

headers.name: x-client-id
headers.description: Client ID of the calling application.

headers.name: x-client-secret
headers.description: Client secret of the calling application.

headers.name: Content-Type
headers.description: The MIME type of the request body: application/json.

request_fields.name: method
request_fields.description: SSO method. Only OAUTH2 is processed; the other values return (17.1).

request_fields.name: token
request_fields.description: JWT issued by the identity provider.

request_fields.name: code
request_fields.description: Authorization code from the identity provider. Not read by the current flow.

request_fields.name: profile_name
request_fields.description: Authentication profile name. Not read by the current flow.

request_fields.name: profile_id
request_fields.description: Authentication profile ID, alternative to profile_name. Not read by the current flow.

request_fields.name: redirect_uri
request_fields.description: Redirect URI used with the authorization code. Not read by the current flow.

request_fields.name: scope
request_fields.description: Scope requested from the identity provider. Not read by the current flow.

response_fields.name: access_token
response_fields.description: Access token to send as `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.

response_fields.name: expires_in
response_fields.description: Seconds until the access token expires.

response_fields.name: refresh_token
response_fields.description: Refresh token, present when one was issued.

response_fields.name: refresh_expires_in
response_fields.description: Seconds until the refresh token expires.

error_codes.condition: 400: body is not a valid SSORequest
401: provider token has no sid (service-issued binding)
401: signature not from the IAM realm
401: no IAM key for the token kid
404: no internal user for the SSO identity
409: SSO identity maps to several users

endpoints.needs_review: DOCX lists code, profile_name and profile_id as mandatory, but the flow never reads them. User and enterprise lookups can also return (1.<stored-procedure status>).

endpoints.name: Login TSE
endpoints.description: Validates a TSE login request for a relying party. The processing step is disabled in code, so a valid request currently returns HTTP 200 with the body `null`.

headers.name: x-language-name
headers.description: Language of the error message. Supported values are `en` and `vi`.

headers.name: Content-Type
headers.description: The MIME type of the request body: application/json.

request_fields.description: User type; must be a RSSP UserType name when present.

error_codes.condition: 400: body is not a valid LoginTSERequest

endpoints.needs_review: Not in DOCX V3. Processing is commented out in AuthorizeService.loginTSE; confirm whether the route is still supported.

headers.name: x-language-name

headers.name: Content-Type

endpoints.needs_review: Not in DOCX V3. A GET with a request body is unusual for clients and proxies.

endpoints.name: Pre Login Authentication
endpoints.description: Checks whether an email belongs to an existing user before login. Lookup failures, including a missing email, are reported as `NOT FOUND` rather than as errors.

headers.name: x-language-name
headers.description: Language of the error message. Supported values are `en` and `vi`.

headers.name: Content-Type
headers.description: The MIME type of the request body: application/json.

request_fields.name: email
request_fields.description: Email of the user to check.

response_fields.name: status
response_fields.description: ACTIVE when a user exists for the email, otherwise NOT FOUND.

endpoints.needs_review: DOCX says Authorization is mandatory, but the route is public (PublicRouteMatcher). DOCX lists status NOT_FOUND; code emits "NOT FOUND" with a space.

endpoints.name: Revoke refresh token
endpoints.description: Revokes the session behind a refresh token so it can no longer be used to obtain access tokens.

headers.name: x-language-name
headers.description: Language of the error message. Supported values are `en` and `vi`.

headers.name: Content-Type
headers.description: The MIME type of the request body: application/json.

request_fields.name: refresh_token
request_fields.description: Refresh token whose session is revoked.

request_fields.name: token_type_hint
request_fields.description: Token type hint. Only `refresh_token` is meaningful; the server ignores it.

error_codes.condition: 400: refresh_token missing or body not JSON

endpoints.needs_review: USP_SESSION_DELETE failures return (1.<stored-procedure status>). token_type_hint is documented as mandatory but never read.

endpoints.name: Get Information
endpoints.description: Returns the application information configured in info.properties together with the current server time. The route is public.

headers.name: x-language-name
headers.description: Language of the error message. Supported values are `en` and `vi`.

endpoints.needs_review: DOCX says Authorization and Content-Type are mandatory; the route is public and reads neither. Keys are raw property names, so a properties change alters the contract.

endpoints.name: Switch Enterprise Context
endpoints.description: Switches the current session to an enterprise profile, or back to the personal context when no positive profile or enterprise ID is given.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer access token.

headers.name: x-language-name
headers.description: Language of the error message. Supported values are `en` and `vi`.

headers.name: Content-Type
headers.description: The MIME type of the request body: application/json.

request_fields.name: profile_id
request_fields.description: Enterprise profile ID to switch to. A value of 0 or less switches to personal.

request_fields.name: enterprise_id
request_fields.description: Enterprise ID to switch to, used only when profile_id is absent.

error_codes.condition: 400: body is not a valid SwitchEnterpriseRequest
400: profile_id not owned by the user
403: user is not a member of enterprise_id
500: unexpected failure or session update failed

endpoints.needs_review: DOCX marks profile_id mandatory; code accepts {} and switches to personal. Lookups can return (1.<stored-procedure status>); RBAC enforce mode adds (5.29)-(5.34).
